source_of_truth: Read by hand: AppBadge fixes color and variant on UBadge — a default the project chose, which the doctrine lists as a reason for a wrapper. AppLink forwards attrs and the slot to <u-link> (ULink in kebab-case) and adds nothing. From the audit of 2026-11-13 (I5, M3).

expected.rationale: kebab-case library root, nothing of its own

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: static attributes on the root are defaults the wrapper adds
